comparison.objective: Commission an adjustable damper versus assemble an inner slide member through its ball retainer.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses recessed tooling and rotary adjustment; record pushes a retainer to its stop, aligns a long member level and square, then rolls/inserts it between constrained rollers.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two safe repeated impacts and lock retention; record requires the member in riding position and seated at the slide's far stop without misalignment or damage.
comparison.reason: The record tests tight-tolerance linear insertion through rolling constraints, not parameter adjustment based on observed dynamics. Candidate response thresholds are partly undeclared.
